title: Customer Upgrade Companion: API contract diff, segmented release highlights, and handoff templates
creator: Asha Patel
description: Produce a customer-facing upgrade companion for platform-2.6 that bundles: a segmented release highlights brief, an API contract diff (backwards-compatibility checklist) for integrating teams, per-customer migration checklists (self-serve vs enterprise vs private), a machine-readable changelog fragment for partner tooling, and channelized communication templates. Goal: reduce support noise during the LTS/rolling crossover and accelerate enterprise acceptance by clarifying breaking/non-breaking changes and exact mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page segmented release highlights PDF (Self-Serve / Dedicated / Private) reviewed by Eng and Security
A2: API contract diff summary that lists endpoints/params changed, semantic-version guidance, and migration snippets (JS/Python)
A3: Per-segment migration checklist with estimated effort and fallbacks for each customer tier
A4: Three communication templates (email, in-product banner, account manager brief) and a short FAQ
A5: Automated changelog fragment (JSON) that partners can ingest, and a sample GitHub Release note for public repo
A6: Sign-off from PM lead and Engineering owner (ENG-7482) and one security reviewer

Technical review with ENG owners to validate diffs and migration snippets (ETA 2026-02-28)

Run small pilot: share companion with 3 beta customers and collect feedback (2026-03-06 to 2026-03-10)
Iterate content based on pilot, finalize automated changelog fragment schema and publish assets (target 2026-03-15)
Schedule mass communications and A/B test banners with 10% audience, ramp to 100% on success (target 2026-03-21)
comms_templates: Email - Self-Serve: Subject: 'Platform 2.6: What changed and what you need to know' body with TL;DR, opt-in migration toggle info, link to self-serve migration guide and sample code snippets
Email - Enterprise: Account-focused brief with impact matrix, recommended migration window, rollback steps, and dedicated AM contact card
In-Product Banner: Short line + link to 'Upgrade Companion' page; variant A for self-serve (action: try migration tool), variant B for enterprise (action: contact AM)
AM Hand-off Template: One-pager for account managers with bullet points: impacted APIs, recommended timeline, known mitigations, estimated engineering hours
FAQ Snippet: 12 most likely customer questions with one-line answers and links to deeper docs
api_contract_diff_summary: Platform-2.6 introduces three API contract changes of note: 1) /v1/generate: default temperature moved from 0.7 to 0.6 (non-breaking but affects output distribution) with guidance to opt back in via query param; 2) streaming chunks now include 'chunk_id' and clients that rely on order should use provided 'sequence' header (backwards compatible if sequence ignored; breaking if client assumed implicit ordering); 3) embeddings endpoint returns an additional 'model_variant' field which is optional to consume. The diff highlights parameter deprecations, new required headers for private deployments (X-Customer-Region), and a pointer to automated SDK upgrade snippets for JS/Python. Semantic-version guidance: all breaking changes are flagged and mapped to explicit migration steps; recommend semver-major for partner-facing SDKs only if consuming deprecated fields.
automation_notes: Changelog fragment produced as JSON with fields: id, summary, impact_level, api_diff_tag, migration_snippet_id
Script to pull ENG changelog markers from PR titles (convention: 'changelog:impact:short-summary') and produce fragment; ENG-8121 implements PR parser
Integrate fragment into release pipeline to populate the 'Upgrade Companion' page via static site generator (Netlify preview for pilot customers)
